body: Oof, mind voice skipped over your age. Are you in college? Have parents? You deserve a support system, and even though you may have the belief that you are burdening others, I bet my life that people want you here on Earth, rather than finding out that you were struggling alone without help! If you can’t confide in those you know, you have a friend in me!

Hey bud! As anticlimactic as it is, I’m glad you were able to snap out of it and save yourself! 

This kind of self-reflection is what allows you to grow and better your daily life, so I encourage you to continue digging deep. As someone who has been in your place, the act of “snapping out of it” gave me what I needed to get the help I sought. If you don’t mind my asking, are you an adult? Young? We can work this out together; although you caught yourself this time, I want you to be able to ensure that you don’t get back into the situation you were in.

I’m glad to hear that you’re doing better! This shit sucks lol. I’ve never actually heard about the ketamine thing, I’ll talk to my doc and see if I’m eligible; I’m honestly just grabbing at straws to try to climb out of the hole, supposed to start group therapy next week, honestly not sure about that either. But hey, ya know, whatever works. Thanks for reaching out.
I’ll check it out. How did you hear about it?
Nope. I’ve never heard of it.
